landing.heroSubtitle: Kaipu Record captures your screen and camera in high quality, right on your machine. Private, fast, and account-free.
landing.featureScreenBody: Record your screen with a floating camera bubble, ready for tutorials and demos.
landing.featurePrivateBody: Everything is processed and stored on your machine. Nothing leaves for the cloud unless you want it to.
landing.featureQualityBody: Pick resolution, smoothness, and file size with clear presets — from light to maximum quality.
landing.featureShortcutsBody: Start, stop, and bring the app to the front from anywhere with rebindable shortcuts.
landing.downloadSubtitle: Free for macOS 11+. Windows coming soon.
